item.title: Echizen Crab: Fukui's Prized Winter Snow Crab — Guide
item.description: Echizen crab, a variety of male snow crab (zuwaigani) landed along Fukui’s coast, is one of Japan’s most prized winter delicacies, distinguished by an official yellow tag attached to each certified crab to guarantee its origin and quality. The crab is in season from around November through March, and coastal towns like Echizen fill with markets and restaurants serving it during these months, prepared as sashimi, boiled, grilled or in hot pot, with prices reflecting its premium status, especially for the largest, highest-graded specimens.
